reason: A diagnostics and recovery plugin for DeepSeek Harness that scans profiles, probes boot failures, and manages local checkpoints and corrective actions through a Web UI and CLI.

summaries.zh: 用于诊断和恢复 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，可扫描配置与启动问题，并通过网页界面或命令行管理本地检查点和修复操作。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness diagnostics and recovery plugin that scans configuration and startup issues and manages local checkpoints and repair actions through a web interface or CLI.

capabilities: diagnoses Harness configuration, dependency, boot, plugin, session, storage, and model-route issues
probes Harness startup and captures boot failures
creates local recovery checkpoints and restores or rolls back profile configuration
can reset configuration, reconcile dependencies, disable selected plugins, quarantine corrupt session files, and re-enable disabled plugins after confirmation
provides Web UI recovery actions and a standalone CLI
